name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
title: Eureka Forbes Ltd - 543482 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +11.6% to INR 684 cr with 13.2% adjusted EBITDA margin, but management guided only to holding FY27 margins amid 6-7% price hike and rising input costs; no capacity or capex signal.

triggers.label: Price hike 6-7% taken April
triggers.quote: we implemented a calibrated price increase of 6% to 7% on an average in April, and we will re main agile as the situation evol ves.

triggers.label: FY27 margin held at least, not grown
triggers.quote: we believe that we should be aiming for at least a margin hold.

triggers.label: Competitors also raised prices
triggers.quote: competition has also responded, and we've seen price hikes being done by every player.

triggers.label: Water purifier growth moderated in FY26
triggers.quote: While water purifiers saw a temporary moderation after strong growth in FY25

triggers.label: Service growth step-up deferred to FY27-28
triggers.quote: some of that revenue may come in FY28 because the share of our multiyear mix in our AMC bookings has gone up quite significantly.

guidance.quote: we should be aiming for at least a margin hold.
one should expect the product growth to be reported in teens when you see the annual report.

guidance.value: more than INR 1,000 crores by FY30
guidance.quote: we expect it to reach more than INR1,000 crores for us by FY30.

red_flags.label: Service revenue growth lagging bookings
red_flags.quote: some of that revenue may come in FY28

red_flags.label: Input cost inflation unresolved
red_flags.quote: Input cost pressures are real with no end in sigh t yet.

evasions.quote: it's difficult to put a specific number at an overall level
